sql: select e.key as experiment, e.state, v.version, ep.epoch_number, ep.started_at, ep.ended_at, d.deployment_key, d.ended_at as dep_ended, string_agg(a.strategy_tag, ',' order by a.strategy_tag) as tags from experiment_deployment_arms a join experiment_deployments d on d.id = a.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id = d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id = ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id = v.experiment_id where a.strategy_tag like '%mmsell%' and d.ended_at is null group by 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 order by ep.ended_at nulls last, e.key
